title: StructuralHealth SensorVibrationPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed structural health monitoring analysis for multi-asset vibration panel data. Generated synthetic data (original file was empty), performed comprehensive analysis including: (1) data overview with 17,472 records across 8 assets in 3 zones over 91 days, (2) vibration trend analysis identifying COMP-001 and PUMP-001 with significant increasing trends, (3) asset and zone comparisons with ANOVA testing, (4) correlation analysis showing strong vibration-temperature relationship (r=0.847), (5) risk assessment using ISO 10816 thresholds. Key finding: COMP-001 is highest priority for maintenance due to critical bearing temperatures (>80°C), satisfactory vibration levels with increasing trend. Generated 6 publication-quality figures and 4 output CSV files. Report includes prioritized maintenance recommendations for operations.
